_comment: Served artifacts that live jobs REWRITE IN PLACE on the operator tree and that are therefore NOT git-tracked (2026-09-03, RenQuant#TBD; same class as the momentum ledgers, RenQuant#638). They exist on disk at these paths on the serving machine and are absent in a fresh checkout / hosted CI. scripts/check_config_artifact_paths.py reads this file: a config field that points at one of these paths and does not resolve is reported as INFO (declared live-mutated), not as a failure — on the serving machine the path resolves and the full identity checks run. Adding a path here is a reviewed deployment change: it says 'CI proves config<->path SHAPE for this artifact, presence + identity are proven only on the serving machine (load-time verification + the shadow-scorer sentinel)'.

writers: scripts/weekly_wf_promote.sh (Step 5 promote / Step 4b fallback pair promote via scripts/fallback_pair_promote.py)
